current_candidate.summary: Spaces v34 preserves v33 visuals and adds a deterministic visual-review harness. The lab now supports review=1 with map/x/z/t query parameters, fixed camera/animation state and hidden UI. A GitHub Actions workflow captures desktop/mobile evidence for all visible scenes plus three tower-depth samples, publishes a contact sheet + manifest, and writes a stable current-review.json pointer so future visual iterations can inspect actual screenshots instead of relying on syntax/SHA checks alone.

open_feedback: Use the generated review contact sheet and current-review.json as first-class evidence before declaring future Spaces visual changes complete.
For TORRES inspect entry/mid/near screenshots because one camera position can hide scale, clipping or signage failures.
Visual review should check composition, scale, clipping, contrast, depth and integration; syntax and blob equality are necessary but not visual acceptance.
Accepted-reference promotion and image-diff can be added later; v34 establishes deterministic capture and publication first.
